title: DILG plans to buy 1,500 Korean-made fire trucks in 2027 for P15B

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) will procure 1,500 new fire trucks in 2027 at a projected cost of P15 billion to address unit shortage and aging fleet, saving the government an estimated P9 billion. “Sa buong Pilipinas meron tayong mga fire trucks na 40 years old, 1986 pa na acquire,” Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said during the blessing and turnover of Unified 911 emergency response vehicles on Wednesday.
